req.title: Unsupported methods rejected
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using an unsupported method against /tasks/{task_id}.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that unsupported HTTP methods should return a 405 status code when used against the /tasks/{task_id} endpoint. This ensures that the API adheres to RESTful principles by rejecting methods that are not implemented. The test suite includes a positive case to verify correct rejection of unsupported methods, a negative case to ensure supported methods work correctly, and a boundary case to test the behavior with an edge case method.

tests.name: test_unsupported_method_rejected
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.patch('/tasks/1')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_supported_method_get_task
expected: The response status code is 404 since no task exists initially.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get('/tasks/1')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_boundary_method_options
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.options('/tasks/1')
assert response.status_code == 405
